input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Sections 19.1–19.5 otherwise meet our position: professional and workmanlike services, material conformity to documentation, no malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, a repair/re-perform/replace-or-refund remedy in 19.4 that is expressly non-exclusive, and a disclaimer in 19.5 that expressly does not cut back the express warranties. The single shortfall is duration: Deliverables (which under Section 1.4 and Section 13.2 include configurations, integrations and embedded software) carry only a ninety-day conformance window, whereas our preferred position is twelve months for software-bearing deliverables. Hosted Services already conform for the whole subscription term, so the minimal edit is to extend the Deliverable window in 19.2 to twelve months; the ninety-day term remains our fallback for non-software work product.

ops.oldText: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.
ops.newText: For twelve months after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Deliverable conformance warranty in Section 19.2 from ninety days to twelve months, consistent with our position that delivered software and work product carry a twelve-month conformance warranty; the Section 19.4 repair, replacement and refund remedy is unchanged. If a twelve-month period is difficult, we can accept ninety days for non-software Deliverables provided software-bearing Deliverables carry twelve months.
proposal.summary: Extend Deliverable conformance warranty period from 90 days to 12 months in Section 19.2.
